import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] valA = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] valB = new long[32][32];
    static int rows, cols, halfLen;
    static char[] pattern;
    static long total, globalMin;
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] fwd = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] bwd = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long[][] pathsCount = new long[32][32];
    static long answer;

    static void record(int x, int y, long sum, long cnt1, long cnt2, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == halfLen) {
            fwd[x][rev ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{sum, cnt1});
            if (cnt2 != 0) {
                bwd[x][rev ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{sum, cnt2});
            }
            return;
        }
        record(x+1, y, sum + (!rev ? valA[x+1][y] : 0), cnt1, (pattern[x+y] != 'B' ? cnt2 : 0), rev);
        record(x, y+1, sum + (rev ? valB[x][y+1] : 0), cnt1, (pattern[x+y] != 'A' ? cnt2 : 0), rev);
    }

    static void explore(int x, int y, long acc, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == halfLen) {
            if (fwd[x][rev ? 1 : 0].isEmpty()) return;
            ArrayList<long[]> list = fwd[x][rev ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (total + 1) / 2 - acc;
            int idx = lowerBound(list, target);
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long diff = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                if (diff < globalMin) globalMin = diff;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long diff = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                    if (diff < globalMin) globalMin = diff;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) explore(x-1, y, acc + (!rev ? valA[x][y] : 0), rev);
        if (y > 0) explore(x, y-1, acc + (rev ? valB[x][y] : 0), rev);
    }

    static void countMatches(int x, int y, long acc, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == halfLen) {
            ArrayList<long[]> list = bwd[x][rev ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (total + 1) / 2 - acc;
            int idx = lowerBound(list, target);
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long diff = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                if (diff == globalMin) answer += list.get(idx)[1];
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long diff = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                    if (diff == globalMin) answer += list.get(idx)[1];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0 && pattern[x+y-1] != 'B') countMatches(x-1, y, acc + (!rev ? valA[x][y] : 0), rev);
        if (y > 0 && pattern[x+y-1] != 'A') countMatches(x, y-1, acc + (rev ? valB[x][y] : 0), rev);
    }

    static void dedup(ArrayList<long[]> v) {
        if (v.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(v, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
        int k = 0;
        long accumulate = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); ++i) {
            accumulate += v.get(i)[1];
            if (i == v.size() - 1 || v.get(i)[0] != v.get(i+1)[0]) {
                v.set(k++, new long[]{v.get(i)[0], accumulate});
                accumulate = 0;
            }
        }
        while (v.size() > k) {
            v.remove(v.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<long[]> list, long target) {
        int left = 0, right = list.size();
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid)[0] >= target) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        rows = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        cols = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        pattern = br.readLine().toCharArray();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
            }
        }

        halfLen = rows + cols;
        total = C[halfLen*2][rows*2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= halfLen; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= halfLen; ++j) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    valA[i][j] = C[i-1][rows-1] * (C[halfLen*2-i][rows] - C[j][rows]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    valB[i][j] = C[j-1][rows-1] * (C[halfLen*2-j][rows] - C[i][rows]);
                }
            }
        }

        pathsCount[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= halfLen; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= halfLen; ++j) {
                if (i < halfLen && pattern[i+j] != 'B') {
                    pathsCount[i+1][j] += pathsCount[i][j];
                }
                if (j < halfLen && pattern[i+j] != 'A') {
                    pathsCount[i][j+1] += pathsCount[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; ++d) {
                fwd[i][d] = new ArrayList<>();
                bwd[i][d] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = rows; i <= halfLen; ++i) {
            if (pattern[i+rows-1] != 'B') {
                record(rows, i, valA[rows][i], C[i+rows-1][rows-1], pathsCount[rows-1][i], false);
            }
            if (pattern[i+rows-1] != 'A') {
                record(i, rows, valB[i][rows], C[i+rows-1][rows-1], pathsCount[i][rows-1], true);
            }
        }

        for (int i = rows; i <= halfLen; ++i) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; ++d) {
                dedup(fwd[i][d]);
                dedup(bwd[i][d]);
            }
        }

        globalMin = total + 1;
        answer = 0;

        explore(halfLen, halfLen, 0, false);
        explore(halfLen, halfLen, 0, true);
        countMatches(halfLen, halfLen, 0, false);
        countMatches(halfLen, halfLen, 0, true);

        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
